lines.en: label mollydorm30:

lines.zh: : 在你不再把那些色情游戏里的东西等同于该怎么对待真实的人之前，你不会“明白”。

lines.en: : The reason there is no “walkthrough” for life is because every single one of us has to do something differently in order to get to the same place someone else is.
lines.zh: : 人生之所以没有“攻略”，是因为我们每个人都必须做不同的事，才能到达别人所在的同一个位置。

lines.en: : For example, Otoha had an easier path to Rin than you did because of some choice Rin made along the way.
lines.zh: : 比如说，Otoha 通往 Rin 的路就比你的好走，因为 Rin 一路上做了某个选择。

lines.en: : In fact, it was so much easier that, even if you played your cards perfectly, the chances of you ending up with her would have been so minuscule that it would have felt like they didn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 事实上，那条路好走得多，就算你把每一步都打得完美无缺，你最后和她在一起的几率也小到像根本不存在一样。

lines.en: : There’s no walkthrough because life sucks. And people suck.
lines.zh: : 没有攻略，是因为人生很烂。人也很烂。

lines.en: : But if you keep failing and failing or whatever, you’ll eventually find some part that doesn’t suck nearly as much.
lines.zh: : 但只要你一直失败、一直失败下去，你最终会找到某个没那么烂的部分。

lines.en: : And indulging in those moments, between when everything feels like shit, has to be better than any sort of game.
lines.zh: : 而在一切都像狗屎的间隙里，沉浸于那些瞬间，肯定比任何游戏都要好。

lines.en: : You have...experience...right, Sir?
lines.zh: : 老师您……有经验……对吧？

lines.en: : I’d say too much of it, but such a thing doesn't exist.
lines.zh: : 要我说还太多了，不过那种事应该不存在上限。

lines.en: : Can you...
lines.zh: : 你能……

lines.en: : Tell me more about what it’s like?
lines.zh: : 再多跟我说说那是什么感觉吗？

lines.en: : To...be with someone for real. And not just in a game.
lines.zh: : 和真人真正在一起……而不是在游戏里。

lines.en: : That depends on what you want to know.
lines.zh: : 那要看你想知道什么。

lines.en: : In games...it’s always romantic and...important. And characters rarely ever don’t enjoy themselves.
lines.zh: : 在游戏里……一切总是浪漫的……而且重要。角色几乎没有不享受的时候。

lines.en: : But...all of those characters are designed to feel that way. They’re designed to melt at the touch of the person they love.
lines.zh: : 可是……那些角色全都是被设计成那种感觉的。她们被设计成在心爱之人的触碰下融化。

lines.en: : Real people aren’t like that. We make mistakes and do things that other people don’t like.
lines.zh: : 真实的人不是那样的。我们会犯错，会做别人不喜欢的事。

lines.en: : I...think I’m just worried that it won’t be what I expect...
lines.zh: : 我……想我只是担心它不会是我期待的样子……

lines.en: : And that I’ll have a harder time choosing to touch a person out here than I would in there...where everything is easier.
lines.zh: : 也担心在现实里选择去触碰一个人，会比在那个一切都更容易的世界里难得多……

lines.en: : Well, the truth is you might.
lines.zh: : 嗯，事实是你可能真的会。

lines.en: : But that’s not something you’ll know until you try it for yourself.
lines.zh: : 但那要你自己试过才会知道。

lines.en: : Think of it like playing a different genre of game or whatever.
lines.zh: : 就当是换了个游戏类型什么的。

lines.en: : And, if you need someone to teach you how to play, I’d be down.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你需要有人教你怎么玩，我可以奉陪。

lines.en: scene mollyporn17
: Sir!
lines.zh: : 老师！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : You want to be one of those heroines you’re always talking about, right?
lines.zh: : 你不是一直说想成为你嘴上那些女主角吗？

lines.en: : Do you really think that’s going to happen if you just stay passive like this?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得，就这么一直被动下去，那会成真吗？

lines.en: : Yes! That’s how it always works in games!
lines.zh: : 会！游戏里一直都是这样的！

lines.en: : The protagonist is the one who is supposed to pursue the love interest! Not the other way around!
lines.zh: : 该去追求恋爱对象的是主角！不是反过来！

lines.en: : Well, maybe it’s time you start thinking about yourself as a protagonist.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许你该开始把自己当成主角了。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m going to just force myself on you and “start your route” or whatever it is you normally say.
lines.zh: : 我又不会硬上你，然后“开启你的路线”什么的，随你怎么说。

lines.en: : But, if you want to start growing up in my sense of what that means, you have a path available.
lines.zh: : 但如果你想按我的那种理解开始长大，你面前是有一条路的。

lines.en: : Which is, and this isn't me trying to sound conceited, a pretty fortunate thing to have in the grand scheme of things.
lines.zh: : 这话听着有点自大，不过从大局来看，能有这样一条路已经相当幸运了。

lines.en: scene mollyporn18
: I...don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……

lines.en: : I’m still confused about a lot of...what I want. And what to do next.
lines.zh: : 我对很多事还很困惑……关于我想要什么。还有下一步该怎么做。

lines.en: : And I’ve also seen some pretty intense virginity scenes in games and...very few have been light on the amount of blood down there...
lines.zh: : 而且我也在游戏里看过一些相当激烈的破处场景……很少有下面不流一大堆血的……

lines.en: : They’re games, so they’re probably just exaggerating.
lines.zh: : 那是游戏，所以大概只是夸张。

lines.en: : But, then again, I still can’t imagine it feeling great.
lines.zh: : 但话又说回来，我还是想象不出那会有多舒服。

lines.en: : I’m just letting you know that the only {i}choice{/i} you’re getting wrong is to keep yourself miserable instead of doing something to get out of it.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你知道，你唯一做错的{i}选择{/i}，就是一直让自己痛苦，而不去做点什么走出来。

lines.en: : It’s not a walkthrough or whatever, but it’s a tip from someone who’s been playing a lot longer.
lines.zh: : 这算不上什么攻略，但这是来自一个玩得比你久得多的人的提示。

lines.en: : Can I at least sleep on it?
lines.zh: : 我至少可以先考虑一晚上吗？

lines.en: : What, you didn’t think I meant right now, did you?
lines.zh: : 什么，你该不会以为我是说现在吧？

lines.en: scene mollyporn19
: Exhibitionism is a tag that’s dramatically increasing in popularity as years go by! It seemed very possible to me!
lines.zh: : 露出癖这个标签的流行度正逐年飙升！我觉得完全有可能！

lines.en: : I don’t know how this goes! If this were a game, we’d probably have done it when we were still in my room earlier!
lines.zh: : 我又不懂这种事怎么发展！如果这是游戏，我们大概早在我房间里时就做了！

lines.en: : Well, I mean-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我是说-

lines.en: scene mollyporn20
: Uhh...no. No, not tonight.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。今晚不行。

lines.en: : I need more time to prepare and...
lines.zh: : 我需要更多时间准备，而且……

lines.en: : I’ve already.........several times...
lines.zh: : 我已经……好几次了……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。

lines.en: : But, if you ever decide to become the protagonist for a little while, you know what you have to do.
lines.zh: : 不过，要是你哪天决定当一小会儿主角，你知道该做什么。

lines.en: : Um...I still...don’t-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我还是……不-

lines.en: scene mollyporn21
: Anyway, it’s fucking cold. And if we’re ending things here, I’m probably just going to head home.
lines.zh: 总之，他妈的冷死了。要是事情就到这儿为止，我大概就回家了。

lines.en: : Oh. Okay. Life continues to not give me enough tips. Excellent.
lines.zh: 哦。好吧。人生继续不肯给我足够的提示。真棒。

lines.en: : I offered you the tip and you said no.
lines.zh: 我给了你提示，是你自己说不的。

lines.en: scene mollyporn22
: We all know it’s never just the tip, Sir!
lines.zh: : 谁都知道那从来都不只是个尖而已，老师！

lines.en: : Sure, it might start that way, but we all know the whole thing would be bulging out of my stomach within a matter of moments!
lines.zh: : 是啊，开头也许只是提示，但我们都清楚，用不了多久，整根就会从我肚子里顶出来！

lines.en: : Unless you’re not well-endowed, which I highly doubt is the case because of your height and role as the protagonist of a dating game!
lines.zh: : 除非您尺寸不行，不过我看您这身高、又是恋爱游戏的主角，尺寸不行的可能性我高度怀疑！

lines.en: : Guess you’ll just have to wait and find out.
lines.zh: : 看来你只能等着瞧了。

lines.en: : Just kidding. It’s definitely big.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。肯定很大。

lines.en: : I knew it.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : Anyway...goodnight, Molly.
lines.zh: : 总之……晚安，Molly。

lines.en: : Have fun fingering yourself to more cartoons.
lines.zh: : 祝你对着卡通角色抠得开心。

lines.en: scene mollyporn23

lines.zh: : 我会的……

lines.en: : Yeah...okay...
: Goodnight, Sir...
lines.zh: : 晚安，老师……

lines.en: scene black
I walk away from Molly without looking back at her because, right now, I’m the cool protagonist that everybody likes.
lines.zh: 我头也不回地从 Molly 身边走开，因为此刻，我就是那个人人都喜欢的帅气主角。

lines.en: But, sooner or later, she’s going to have to take matters into her own hands.
lines.zh: 但迟早，她得自己掌握这件事。

lines.en: Or just submit to the prospect that she’ll never know the touch of a real, live human and just keep holing herself up inside of her dorm.
lines.zh: 或者干脆认命，接受自己永远不会知道一个活生生的真人的触碰，就这么一直窝在宿舍里。

lines.en: But, if the last few days I’ve spent with Molly are any indication of where she’s headed as a person...
lines.zh: 不过，如果我最近和 Molly 相处的这几天能说明她这个人正走向何方……

lines.en: I think she might wind up making that choice sooner than anticipated.
lines.zh: 我想她做出那个选择的时间，可能会比预想的要早。
